description: Enterprise AI-agent platform for building, deploying, governing, evaluating, and monitoring coordinated AI agents across business workflows.

evidence.finding: Relevance AI documents role-based access control, SSO and SAML, data residency, and governed access controls for agents operating on enterprise systems.
Relevance AI allows customers to cancel subscriptions and keeps access through the current billing cycle so they have an opportunity to retrieve needed data before access ends.
Relevance AI documents real-time monitoring, full agent tracing, audit logs, cost visibility, evaluations, and production sampling for agent behavior.
Relevance AI explicitly lists human-in-the-loop approvals and approval gates as enterprise controls for agent actions.
Relevance AI offers a free plan without requiring a credit card and publishes paid tiers for individuals, teams, businesses, and enterprises.
Relevance AI states that users may request access, transfer, or deletion of personal data and documents additional correction, erasure, restriction, and transfer rights where applicable.
Relevance AI states that enterprise customer data is not used to train models, while its terms grant a service-provision and improvement license over Client Data rather than transferring ownership.
Relevance AI supports customer-provided API keys, many model providers, more than one thousand integrations, MCP, and CSV export of analysis results.
Relevance AI publishes tier pricing and states that vendor model credits are charged at cost without markup, while customer-supplied API keys avoid vendor-credit charges for those model calls.
Relevance AI supports team-built agent workforces, Slack interaction, shared multi-agent systems, and operations dashboards intended for experts who own agent quality and outcomes.
Relevance AI combines autonomous agent workflows with human-in-the-loop approvals, version control, evaluation gates, and monitoring rather than treating autonomy as ungoverned execution.
Relevance AI provides a no-card free plan and describes building agents in plain language, enabling non-technical teams to create workflows without starting from code.

limitations: This preliminary audit uses public Relevance AI primary-source documentation and has not been reviewed by Relevance AI.
Published product documentation is evidence of documented controls and policies, not proof of real-world outcomes for every deployment.
Humanity Score is a product-impact rating, not a regulatory, legal, safety, compliance, or government certification.
correction_policy: Source-backed factual corrections are welcome. Corrections change the audit only when the underlying evidence changes; payment cannot buy a higher score.
